decided: The instruction now says that when an amendment of a ruling or goal, an outward act, or an unresolvable critical finding happens without the AI asking (the user directed it, or nothing asks), the AI still writes the stop before acting, and records the user's direction as its answer when there was one.
alternatives: record such a stop only when the AI asks a question, leaving directed amendments unrecorded
why: The first run's goal that stops are complete counts every event meeting one of the ratified stop conditions, whether or not anyone was asked; an instruction that recorded only questions would miss them.
